sources.title: Experimental Aeroelastic Benchmark of a Very Flexible Wing
sources.kind: Primary authors paper; author-uploaded full text

locators.page: Page not independently resolved; use section and retained web-line locator
locators.finding: MRS coordinates are calibrated X chord, Y span, Z out of plane. The structural-test description does not specify a Test 2 export rotation matrix.
Initially nonstraight wing and about -1 degree built-in twist; the Test 1 displayed incremental results exclude this built-in twist. This is not evidence for adjusting Test 2 export values.
Commands held approximately 15 seconds; MRS at 120 Hz. Trend plots use a 500-sample moving average on MRS and tunnel data. Test 2 export filter/window is not established.
This is the current comparison campaign, distinct from the preceding Test 1. Previously retained mounting, tip mass and dynamic indicators are unchanged.

sources.title: Large Deformation Shape Sensing Using a Nonlinear Strain to Displacement Method
sources.kind: Primary authors paper; author-uploaded full text

locators.finding: Twist is computed from differential leading/trailing-edge x and z positions via arctangent in that paper’s coordinate convention.

A 7 degree sweep to 55 m/s is separated into slowly varying and oscillatory components using 1 Hz low/high-pass filters. Reflections, camera position restrictions and loss of line of sight cause errors/offsets at large deformation; twist is especially sensitive. The rough 1 mm to 0.8 degree sensitivity is not a current Test 2 statistical uncertainty band.

sources.applicability: This 7 degree / 55 m/s sweep is not established as the current Test 2 export, whose reported speed range is different. Neither its filter nor uncertainty estimate is transferred to current data.

sources.title: Impact of Low-Order Modeling on Aeroelastic Predictions for Very Flexible Wings

locators.finding: Identifies Avin Test 2. Midchord displacement is directly measured at 5 degrees and estimated from LE/TE mean at 7 degrees; twist uses differential LE/TE positions. These were already in the retained source scope.

unresolved_current_test2_export.missing: Camera calibration matrix and treatment of rigid root incidence; calibrated chord/span/normal language does not decide root-normal versus tunnel-normal export.
Exact retained zero/reference record, built-in twist removal, whether subtraction precedes averaging or angle recovery; Test 1 initial -1 degree does not authorize a Test 2 shift.
Current Test 2 filtering, windowing, speed pairing/resampling and angle/position averaging order. A static equilibrium is not thereby a measured oscillatory mean.
Campaign- and exported-point-specific covariance/uncertainty. Other test estimates cannot become acceptance bands.

conclusion: No new source-supported axis, baseline, gravity or coefficient correction is established. A closer RMSE under an alternative projection is not evidence that its measurement convention is correct.
